about: {name} is a kids' activewear brand created by the founders of Aww Baby and sold through the Aww Baby store.
description: {name} case study: launching a kids' activewear brand inside the Aww Baby store, with brand marketing, store pages, social, ads and AI-assisted shoots.
channels: Brand, collection and product pages on Aww Baby
brief: {name} is a kids' activewear brand, created by the founders of Aww Baby as one of their own labels. They wanted to enter kids' sportswear and launch {name} inside Aww Baby, their kids' shopping platform.

We ran the whole launch: brand marketing, the {name} pages on the website, social media, performance marketing, and AI-assisted shoots and content creation. It all rests on one idea for parents: a soft bamboo and spandex fabric that keeps kids comfortable, even in extreme heat.

showcases.title: A brand page of its own inside Aww Baby
showcases.text: {name} has its own menu in the Aww Baby store and a brand page that opens on kids in motion. Fabric benefits such as breathable, 4-way stretch and buttery soft run under the banner.

showcases.title: Comfort parents can feel, even in the heat
showcases.text: The fabric is the reason to buy, so the store shows it plainly: 95% bamboo and 5% spandex in the tees, soft, breathable and anti-microbial. The same message carries into the product pages, social and ads.

showcases.title: A collection that leads with the fabric
showcases.text: A Bamboo Fabric badge on each tee, filters for availability and price, and a two-column grid on the phone. Payment options sit in the collection header.

showcases.title: Fabric details one tap from add to cart
showcases.text: Sizes by age, the price inclusive of taxes, the free delivery threshold, UPI, card and cash on delivery. The fabric and wash care sit just below add to cart.

showcases.title: A first-order offer for {name}
showcases.text: The cart shows a {name} code next to the store-wide one, so a parent buying {name} for the first time has a reason to check out today.

showcases.title: Social tiles, a Meta ad and a Google Shopping ad
showcases.text: Launch creative from AI-assisted shoots: kids running, playing tennis, cycling and stretching, in the same lilac palette as the store, so an ad and the page it opens read as one brand.

showcases.title: {name} activewear on kids at play
showcases.text: Product photography from the same project.
